title: Reconciliation v3 alert event payload
description: Payload of every reconciliation alert event, envelope version v3. Draft: no code publishes it yet. The alert object follows the Alert schema of docs/drafts/openapi-v3.yaml. Later v3 minors only add fields and enum values: consumers ignore what they do not know.

alert.description: The alert as it stands right after the transition, as GET /alerts/{alertID} returns it.

rule.description: The rule that raised the alert, enough to route or title a notification without an API call.

kind.description: Matches the event type: opened is OPENED_ALERT, and so on.

from.description: Status before the transition. Absent for opened.

alertVersion.description: The alert version after the transition. Per alert, versions grow by one: apply an event only when its alertVersion is greater than the last one applied.

transactionID.description: The control ledger transaction that recorded the transition. With the control ledger name and the transaction timestamp, it forms the envelope idempotency_key.

evaluationID.description: The evaluation behind an opened, updated, reopened or automatic resolved transition.

by.description: The caller behind an acknowledged, resolved or accepted transition, from its token.

reason.description: For resolved: auto (a passing evaluation) or fixed_by_booking. For reopened: evidence_changed or acceptance_expired after an acceptance, or new_failure after a resolution.

fingerprint.description: asset:USD/2 for a template outcome; evaluation.failed or alert.cap for a meta-alert.

occurrenceCount.description: Number of failing evaluations since the alert opened.

evidence.description: The latest outcome evidence, as in the Evidence schema of the contract.
